data_fields.name: cheat_switch_pairs
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 cheat switches, each with a sticky score twin (hear, room, xtra, live)

data_fields.name: taint_mark_wizard_debug_borg

data_fields.name: total_winner_exempts_end_refusal
data_fields.donor_constant: interrupt and retire refused unless total winner; cheat and wizard refusals are not exempted

best_idea: Mark a run tainted with a sticky flag that the server sets in the same write as the cheat action, and refuse XP, loot and leaderboard credit at award time while play continues.
decision_why: The shadow-twin and sticky-mark shape is worth taking. Angband's trust model (flag in a local savefile the player can edit) is not; Frankendom's ledger is server-held and kills are server-verified, so the taint must be server-set only.
acceptance: A server test: a character flagged by an admin debug action wins a fight; the server writes the ledger entry with the taint set, credits no XP and no loot, and the taint survives a reconnect and a server restart; a client message that tries to set the taint is rejected.
